title: Creativity, Inc.
author: Ed Catmull
summary: Pixar co-founder Ed Catmull tells how the studio grew from a computer graphics group into a film powerhouse, and what he learned about candor, failure and protecting creative teams as they scale.
readIf: you manage creative people or are curious about how Pixar was run from the inside.
skipIf: you want a gossipy film history or a short list of management tips.
